purpose: Preregistered decision on whether UTurnRule::MomentumSum (Stan's generalised no-U-turn criterion on the summed leaf momenta with the 2.21+ cross checks; opt-in since STUDIES/kernel_efficiency_v1) becomes the sampler::Tuning::default() kernel option for 0.2.0. Evidence: the posteriordb_bench_v3 protocol restricted to the oWALNUTS arms with the U-turn rule as the only difference between arms, fresh seeds; the Neal's funnel tail-mass check at the paper tuning and at the sampler defaults; the noncentered Eight Schools strict track of eight_schools_v9_rebench_v1.

predecessors.candidate_source: STUDIES/kernel_efficiency_v1 (MomentumSum: 0.81x -> 1.09x reference NUTS on a 100-D Gaussian, 1.07x on a 50-D correlated Gaussian, 0.86x vs 0.91x on Eight Schools inside +-10 % seed spread; funnel tail mass preserved at the paper tuning, one seed)
predecessors.posteriordb_reference: STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v3 (seeds 79101-79103): owalnuts-da 35/51 gates, geomean 0.344x CmdStan min bulk ESS/gradient over 17 models; CmdStan and nutpie are NOT rerun here, their v3 seed medians are cited from its artifacts/summary.json
predecessors.funnel_defaults_reference: STUDIES/freeze_mode_v1 checks: Endpoints at the sampler defaults, seed 0x0f0f2026, tail mass 0.0236 +- 0.0142 (z -1.70), 812 retained exhaustions; its finding that accepting rules on retained draws lose the funnel neck at four levels is why only the U-turn rule (not the exhaustion rule) is a candidate here
predecessors.eight_schools_reference: STUDIES/eight_schools_v9_rebench_v1: fresh seeds 88001-88003, min-over-functionals bulk ESS/call 0.01695-0.01762 (v9 kernel, no initial-evaluation cache)

kernel_under_test.extra_arm: UTurnRule::EndpointsWithCross (reported, not a flip candidate; kernel_efficiency_v1: same Gaussian gain, worse on Eight Schools, not Stan's rule)
kernel_under_test.api: owalnuts::sampler (Sampler, Init::uniform(), Tuning::default().kernel_options(..), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation::default()); harness src/main.rs is posteriordb_bench_v3/src/main.rs with the arm selecting KernelOptions::u_turn instead of the warmup mode
kernel_under_test.sampler_defaults_at_freeze: h0 0.5, depth 10, min_micro_steps 1, 4 refinement levels, delta 1, divergence threshold 1000, dual averaging 0.8, DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION AcceptUnlessDivergent (WP24), adapted diagonal metric, initial-evaluation cache on

posteriordb.models_compiled: fresh, BridgeStan 2.9.0 / Stan 2.39.0, no STAN_THREADS, same flags as v3 (the v3 libraries were not kept)

arms.owalnuts-da: UTurnRule::Endpoints (the current default); otherwise identical to posteriordb_bench_v3 owalnuts-da

common.target: owalnuts-bridgestan ReplicatedStanTarget, 4 replicas, non-STAN_THREADS BridgeStan build
common.warmup: Adaptation::default() (dual averaging 0.8, WP24 warmup exhaustion rule), Metric::diagonal()
common.starts: sampler::Init::uniform() via uniform_starts(seed): the three arms share the starts of a seed

seeds_verified_unused: grep of wiki/, STUDIES/, src/, tests/, examples/ before freezing: no occurrence as a seed
run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-da, owalnuts-da-rhosum, owalnuts-da-cross; seeds ascending; strictly sequential; then the funnel and Eight Schools checks
parameter_set: columns of the posteriordb reference draws; draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain(include_tp=True)
estimators: arviz 0.23.4: rank rhat; bulk ESS; tail ESS prob (0.05, 0.95); mcse method mean — as v3
metrics: as posteriordb_bench_v3: gradients_total = target calls (start search + warmup + sampling, all chains); min over reference parameters of bulk ESS / gradients_total is the decision statistic; wall, ESS/s, sampling-only variants, agreement z and the frozen-chain flag reported

funnel.target: Neal's 10-D funnel, omega ~ N(0, 9), x_i | omega ~ N(0, e^omega); exact P(omega < -5) = 0.0478

tunings.paper: examples/funnel_kernel_options.rs protocol: Adaptation::Paper(default), Metric::Identity, h 0.1, depth 10, 8 levels, delta 1
tunings.defaults: freeze_mode_v1 checks protocol: Tuning::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation::default()

funnel.statistic: tail-mass estimate pooled over the three seeds (240,000 draws), batch-means s.e. over 480 batches of 500 draws; z = (estimate - exact) / s.e.; per-seed z also reported

eight_schools.protocol: STUDIES/eight_schools_v9_rebench_v1 settings verbatim: noncentered Eight Schools (mu, log tau, z_1..z_8), starts log tau in {-2, -1, 0, 1}, RunConfig 1,000/1,000, KernelTuning h 0.3, depth 8, min_micro_steps 1, 8 levels, delta 1, divergence threshold 1000, WarmupConfig::new(0.95) with mass adaptation, threads 1, sample_chains_with_target_budget (walnutpie facade: no initial-evaluation cache), callback cap 1e7
eight_schools.statistic: min over the six v38 functionals (mu, tau, mean_theta, sd_theta, theta_1, theta_8) of arviz bulk ESS divided by callbacks started; geometric mean over the three seeds; ratio rhosum / endpoints
eight_schools.health: bulk and tail ESS >= 400 on every functional, rank R-hat <= 1.01, zero divergences, zero refinement exhaustions (reported)

decision_rule.statement: Flip sampler::Tuning::default() to UTurnRule::MomentumSum if and only if all four hold; otherwise leave the default and report why.
decision_rule.C1: geometric mean over the 17 models of the seed-median min-bulk-ESS/gradient ratio owalnuts-da-rhosum / owalnuts-da >= 1.10 (a model with a missing median on either side is excluded from the geomean and reported)
decision_rule.C2: no model has that ratio below 0.85
decision_rule.C3: the pooled funnel tail-mass z for rhosum is within +-2 of 0.0478 under both the paper tuning and the sampler defaults (the endpoints control is reported alongside; freeze_mode_v1 measured it at z -1.70 on one seed at the defaults)
decision_rule.C4: Eight Schools strict-track geomean min-bulk-ESS/call ratio rhosum / endpoints >= 0.9
decision_rule.not_gated: the cross arm (reported only); gate counts (reported; expected within +-2 cells of the endpoint arm because the rule changes orbit length, not the leaf test); wall (shared machine, upper bounds)

expectations_not_gated.E1: the largest gains on the models the adapted diagonal metric makes nearly isotropic (arK, garch11, mesquite, hmm_example, kidiq, nes): kernel_efficiency_v1 saw +35 % on an isotropic Gaussian and 0 % on a correlated one
expectations_not_gated.E2: gradient counts per cell fall by 5-25 % on the isotropic models (shorter orbits) and are within +-5 % on earnings/sblrc/accel_gp (depth-capped at small steps, where the rule rarely decides)
expectations_not_gated.E3: hmm_drive_0's second-mode chains and sblrc's step collapse recur on some seeds in every arm (start-mode and adaptation questions, not U-turn questions); they enter the geomean as they fall
expectations_not_gated.E4: owalnuts-da reproduces the v3 owalnuts-da within seed noise (geomean v1/v3 ESS/gradient 0.8-1.25 on the healthy models)

decision_rules: Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results. A driver crash is relaunched and the interrupted cell re-run from scratch (seeded), recorded as a deviation. If the decision passes, the flip is a separate labelled final commit that changes Tuning::default() (sampler only; walnutpie::KernelOptions::default() and tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs are untouched) and updates tests/sampler_api.rs, README, CHANGELOG and wiki/release-0.2.0.md.
